items.title: Amazon (AMZN) is About to 6X Its Drone Delivery Footprint to Compete With Rivals Like DoorDash (DASH)
items.summary: Amazon.com, Inc. items.title: Gap Stock Jumps After Strong Earnings, Upbeat Guidance, and a New Old Navy CEO
items.summary: Gap earns 52 cents a share in its fiscal second quarter, excluding tariff refund benefits, on revenue that fell 2% from the year-ago period to $3.65 billion.

items.title: How to Play Meta Platforms Stock Before It Launches a Consumer AI Agent

items.title: Circle Internet stock falls after banks eye stablecoin launch
items.summary: Investing.com -- Circle Internet Group (NYSE:CRCL) shares fell 4% Wednesday following a Wall Street Journal report that banks are now considering launching their own stablecoins after previously opposing them.
